Navy Federal Credit Union is a financial services organization whose Cognitive and Generative-AI Engineering team develops and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance and scale AI adoption. The Summer Associate Intern will support AI engineering projects, conduct research and analysis, assist with data and operational tasks, and collaborate with staff across the organization.

Responsibilities
Perform research and analysis; may include quantitative and/or qualitative analysis
Assist with AI Engineering tasks and projects
Provide support to assigned department; may work on small projects or portions of larger projects
Support business strategy and initiatives within the business unit and/or across the organization
Assist and collaborate with various levels of staff to accomplish tasks/assignments
Maintain professionalism in all interactions, placing member service as priority
Provide comprehensive day-to-day operational support
Provide support in functional areas of the credit union
Process and update data in automated systems; may generate and analyze reports
Perform other duties as assigned

Required
To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later
* Currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university
* Strong foundation in Computer Science or Data Science
* Experience with programming languages such as Python
* Understanding of Generative-AI concepts and Large Language Models (LLMs), including their applications and limitations
* Familiarity with Prompt Engineering, AI search techniques, vector databases, LangGraph and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks
* Knowledge of Data Engineering, APIs, and cloud development
* Adaptability to new technologies
* Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
* Effective communication skills and a commitment to self-development
* Strong organizational, planning, and time management skills
